about: The introitus of the formulary “The Holy Innocents, Martyrs” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: From the mouth of infants, O God, and of nursing babes, You have perfected praise because of Your enemies. O Lord, our Lord, how wonderful is Your name in all the earth! Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. From the mouth of infants, O God, and of nursing babes, You have perfected praise because of Your enemies.
